title: Ancillary messages and capability transfer
summary: sendmsg/recvmsg are expressed as managed Foreign Runtime pointer graphs while the flexible cmsghdr byte stream is constructed and parsed in ooRexx from profile-qualified offsets/alignment and ABI-native scalar widths.
invariants: The msghdr -> iovec -> payload/control/name resource graph stays pinned transitively for the native call.
SCM_RIGHTS is capability transfer and received descriptor ownership must be explicit.
On MSG_CTRUNC or an excess descriptor count, identifiable received descriptors are closed and the operation fails with EMSGSIZE.
No partial capability set is exposed after ancillary truncation.
Raw pointer extraction must not bypass Foreign Runtime managed-resource pinning.
procedure: Use UnixMessage and sendDescriptors/recvDescriptors rather than exposing raw cmsghdr buffers to callers.

provenance.claim: recvMessage/sendDescriptors implement managed msghdr graphs, ancillary parsing, SCM_RIGHTS transfer, and fail-closed truncation.
